root_cause_label: Incomplete Implementation with Generic Probe-and-Guess Fallback Code
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent lacked knowledge of the correct Jaxley channel API and replaced the required biophysical channel implementation (HH kinetics, CaD, KCa) with a generic try/except probe-and-guess loop over speculative class names that could not reproduce the NEURON model dynamics.
t_err_evidence: At step 13, the agent first writes add_channels() via applypatch using multiple try/except loops guessing at non-existent Jaxley class names (jx.channels.Passive, NaChannel, HHNa, NaV, KChannel, HHK, Kv, CaChannel, HVCa, KCaChannel, CaDecay, CaDyn) rather than implementing the actual biophysics (HH-like mammalian_spike_35 gating, CaDyn, KCa), demonstrating a fundamental knowledge_gap in the Jaxley API and the biophysics mapping.
t_commit_evidence: At step 19, the agent performs a full file rewrite via cat-heredoc cementing the same generic probe-and-guess approach with identical fallback try/except API-guessing logic, omitting KCa and Ca dynamics, and applying only approximate Leak/Na/K/CaL channels. The same flawed architecture persists unchanged through steps 29, 34, 39, and 42, making the failure irreversible given the agent's actual behavior.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked domain knowledge of both the correct Jaxley channel API (actual class names, constructor signatures, and insertion methods for cell groups) and the biophysics mapping required to translate NEURON's mammalian_spike_35 mechanism plus calcium dynamics (CaD, KCa) into Jaxley channel classes. Instead of discovering the real API by reading Jaxley source files, it resorted to guessing at multiple plausible class names wrapped in try/except.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 11, 17, 24, 28, 33, 36, 37 all show '(command executed successfully with no output)' when probing jaxley channels and cell APIs, indicating the introspection commands failed silently and the agent never actually saw which channel classes existed or how the API worked. This should have prompted a different strategy (reading Jaxley source files directly).
